blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Flag carrier Philippine Airlines (PAL) said Monday it was extending the suspension of its flights to and from Riyadh until Nov. 29 amid continuing security threats to the Saudi capital’s international airport. The latest advisory covers both inbound and outbound services, and extends a suspension first imposed on Oct. 8 and subsequently extended until Oct. 11. READ: At least 12 dead in Riyadh airport attack – Saudi officials PAL cited the “evolving security situation at Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport” as the reason for the extended cancellations.
